title: Cocycle quotient for the hypercohomology edge
statement: Let $B,C$ be Grothendieck abelian categories with derived categories, $G:B\to C$ additive left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive], $K$ a natural-indexed cochain complex and $n\geq0$. Let $c:G(Z^nK)\to Z^n(GK)$ satisfy $c\circ i_{GK}=G(i_K)$. For the canonical complex edge $\ell_G(K,n)$ [def-pc-hypercohomology-left-edge], one has $c\circ\pi_{GK}\circ\ell_G(K,n)=G(\pi_K)$, where $\pi$ is the cycles-to-homology quotient. There is no acyclicity assumption on terms, no initial functor $F$, and no injective resolution of an original object.

source.place: Tags 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor) and 015N (lemma-grothendieck-spectral-sequence); representative calculation expanded from lem-pc-grothendieck-cocycle-comparison

proof.text: Choose a Cartan--Eilenberg resolution of the zero extension. Apply G and use the split horizontal-cohomology quotient comparison in each resolution degree.

The derived unit sends the supplied cycle lift to the augmentation representative. Naturality of the homology quotient identifies its resolution-degree-zero component with G(π_K) followed by the resolved cohomology augmentation. The kernel in resolution degree zero is G(H^nK), with no incoming boundary. The stable inclusion preserves this component and (-1)^(n*0)=1. Under the canonical truncation edge and its target comparisons this is precisely the stated map. Cancel the extension comparisons.
